doc.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004

title: Being picky about song titles
summary: Titles get settled when the record is due. Fleck keeps a list and waits until one clicks with the song.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Do you have trouble thinking of titles sometimes?

Yeah. I’m really picky about titles, and usually the crunch is when it’s time for the record to come out, that’s when the titles have to get settled. So I keep a list of titles now in my computer and I’ll look through them. And often I don’t find anything that fits the song. I want it to really fit. And again, why it fits the song, I can’t tell you, but when it’s the right one it clicks in and I go, oh, that feels right.
